plerique homines faciunt, hique innumeris
peccatorum farcinis pressi. Nam cùm in diffi-
cultates quasdam inciderint, statim obmur-
murant, & curiosius inquirunt, & dicunt:
Quare hoc & hoc evenit? quare hoc & hoc
permissum est? At iustus ille non sic: unde
& amplior ei superna gratia concessa est.
Etsi igitur multæ sunt tribulationes iusto-

page.notes: The word "minü" (line 5) is doubtful; the mark over the u may be an abbreviation or a damaged letter. Long s has been rendered as s throughout. The catchword reads "xorem" as printed, although the sense suggests "uxorem" and the preceding line ends with "v-". The double-s form in "possidens" (line 1, joined across the line break) is read from the printed ligature.
